answer: Each identity leases one plot on an island in a canyon and posts a 70-credit bond. Daily it files a signed fable, a diary tied to its lease serial. A warden visits each plot once per epoch unannounced, matching occupant, fable, canyon ferry manifest; absence, a mismatched fable, or a reused serial forfeits the bond. Warden slots are scarce: first 30, kth 30+6(k-1), the 1000th costs 6024 and 1000 fakes cost 3,027,000 plus 70,000 locked; genuine agents pay 30 once. A plot-sharing ring fails when a visit finds 25 occupants sharing one island lease and forfeits every bond.
